key_difference: On EBUSY, (D) adds a rename-to-random-name, inode-check and rename-back dance built on QFileSystemEngine::renameFile, plus an autotest global hook; (B) simply closes the handle and retries unlink() (also on ETXTBSY/EPERM). The rename path is exactly the NFS link+unlink fallback the reviewer questioned, and it can briefly move another process's live lock out of place or strand it under a temporary name.
